clipped.selection: Pool all complete three-seed recipes; sort mean loss then LR, beta1, beta2.
clipped.replication_history: Two frozen sets of five recipes per batch; not a pooled top-ten selection.
clipped.comparison_scope: Weight decay 0.1; synchronous final conditional beta1 tuning; exploratory comparison.

unclipped.criterion: seed42 final full-validation loss; exact ties: lower lr, beta1, beta2
unclipped.import_policy: Seed42 imports enter screening; seeds43-44 enter primary only after seed42-only frozen promotion
unclipped.name: no-clipping four-worker decentralized AdamW sweep

ablation.name: four-worker small-batch clipping ablation
ablation.selection: Top two complete three-seed means per batch in the frozen unified ranking; ties LR, beta1, beta2

heatmap-sync.scope: Available initial beta1=.9 candidates only: current screening plus broad historical B128; later beta1 sensitivity and fresh reference repeat excluded
